title: Discover the job of commercial attaché at Arval BNP Paribas Group
description: The mission of the commercial attaché is to manage the commercial and operational support of the account team to ensure the success of the customer relations! Discover our trades and our offers on https://www.arval.fr/carrieres/

asr.full_text: I've been a business associate at Public LLD Arval for a year. My previous training was a.B.A. Economics and Social followed by a BTS Sales Force. I've been at Arval for almost four years and I have a BTS in accounting so I take care of everything that is vehicle renewal for a large fleet of accounts. I've been a business associate at Arval for four years now. My main mission will be to be the customer's interlocutor in terms of quotation, also adjustment and parking monitoring. My core missions are to be in the board's hearing, analyzing its proposal and guiding it to the best vehicle demand. To be curious about the configurations of vehicles, to be careful not to make mistakes, and to be strict when ordering vehicles. The basis and the result is total customer satisfaction. Today, the advice I would have for a future candidate, in any case, if he is looking for a company where he can have prospects for evolution and signals of internal mobility, I would strongly advise him to join our company. Arval in three words, the green color because it is our symbol.
